corners.name: Brevard & Preston
corners.note: Emmanuel read id/201 himself. Dolphin is between Brevard and Preston and they don't meet. Brevard is only behind Dolphin (on one side, not both sides). Reading order along the diagram: Greenmount, Aisquith, Central, Caroline, then three dots, then Preston. The written route on id/197 lists Dolphin, Brevard, Preston, so the corner's exact position is unresolved.
